result:
I wrote `component.html` in the notifications/5 folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Layout:** Everything sits inside `#component` (1280px wide) on white. The content column is 1120px wide and centered, with 48px above it and 32px side padding.
- **Top row:** The "Notifications" heading is on the left in Unbounded Light caps. The "Mark All as Read" button is on the right as the single ink-filled pill, 44px tall.
- **List:** The six notifications are in one bordered card. Rows are at least 52px tall, with 1px dividers and 14px text. The time is on the right in the muted colour.
- **Unread:** The first three rows have a blue dot and semibold text. Screen readers also get a hidden "Unread:" prefix, which isn't visible.
- **Tokens:** I copied only the light-theme tokens the page uses into the file, so it is self-contained. All colours, sizes and spacing come from those tokens, with no raw hex in the component styles.
- **Fonts:** There are no font files in the folder, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to system fonts unless they're installed.
